Building blocks Assume that $\Phi :\mathbb{R}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$ is a smooth cutoff function supported on the interval $(0,\lambda_{1}^{-1}]$ and $\int_{\mathbb{R}}\Phi^{\prime\prime}(x)\mathrm{d} x=0$ .
